svg.aria-label: Data Generation for Software Testing & Debugging Experimentation. Software Analysis & Experimentation Group (SAEG) · advised by Prof. Dr. Marcos Lordello Chaim. Pipeline: Bugs.jar: real bugs, 8 Apache projects; Run the tests: every faulty version, Linux; Jaguar 2: line & control-flow coverage; Open dataset: for fault localization. Bugs from Accumulo, Camel, Commons Math, Flink, Jackrabbit Oak, Log4j 2, Maven, Wicket.
